{{Top|leg}}
A '''skyship''' was a type of sports craft manufactured by [[OmoTact Corporation]]. There were several varieties, ranging in size from seven to fifteen [[Meter/Legends|meters]], and required between eight and twenty sailors to crew. The hulls were double walled and made of an ulta light [[Desh/Legends|desh]]&ndash;[[terenthium]] alloy. The space between the hull was filled with [[heglum]], a synthetic gas. They featured masts and sails for speed and directional movement. All skyskips on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] were equipped with [[Ponrez/Arc repulsorlift engine]]s built by [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]] in case of a lack of breeze to operate the sails. One model of skyship was the [[Roahks 7m Skyship]].
